{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''colony''' of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]] that eventually lost contact with [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large and reverted to simple technology, such as wooden sailing ships. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the existence of the long-dead colony was discovered after a sailing ship was dredged from the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Sailing into Fate}}</ref>
